financial_quality.judgment: Earnings quality is strong: CFO exceeds attributable profit and deduct-profit growth is healthy; online growth is material rather than purely narrative.

market_implied_expectation.interpretation: Current valuation already requires sustained double-digit earnings growth and successful multi-brand execution; the business is attractive, but the margin of safety is not yet sufficient for a 15% new-capital hurdle.

operating_detail.judgment: Channel productivity is improving, but inventory and impairment are the key balance-sheet/earnings-quality counters to the growth thesis; new-brand expansion also adds execution risk.

source_quality_note: Consolidated H1 figures are from the formal report summary/reprints; detailed channel and inventory figures are from the full-report mirror. Market price is the completed 2026-09-15 session. Scenario EPS, multiples and probabilities are analytical assumptions.

sources.title: 比音勒芬2026年半年度报告摘要
比音勒芬2026年半年度报告全文

thesis.core: Core-brand growth remains healthy, online revenue is accelerating and H1 operating cash flow grew much faster than profit, supporting a high-quality earnings profile.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use 2026 normalized EPS bear/base/bull of RMB1.15/RMB1.32/RMB1.48, with H1 EPS RMB0.86 as the reported anchor and a conservative seasonal/full-year normalization.
thesis.variant_wedge: The business quality is stronger than many discretionary-apparel peers, but at the current price the valuation already recognizes much of the growth; inventory and impairment plus multi-brand expansion keep new-capital expected return below the system's 15% hurdle.

catalysts: Online growth remains high-margin while direct-store productivity improves.
Inventory turns and impairment stabilize despite continued revenue growth.
New brands and licensed brands progress toward break-even without diluting core-brand ROIC.
Core-brand earnings compound faster than the valuation multiple compresses.
kill_thesis: Online growth proves promotional or materially lower quality than reported gross-margin economics imply.
Inventory and impairment grow persistently faster than revenue and cash earnings.
Multi-brand expansion consumes capital without a credible path to acceptable ROIC.
Core-brand growth slows materially while the equity remains priced above roughly 20x normalized earnings.
